Rae (Docs): quick heads-up: PR 6210 preview is failing because the dashboard preset example uses the old `presets.costLabels` field, runtime now expects `presets.labels.cost`. getting a render error in the site.
Ben (Eng-Obs): thanks, that rename slipped through the migration checklist. we introduced `presets.labels.*` last sprint to unify label groups. docs need a tiny update.
Ivy (SDK): i can patch the snippet across node/python/go. will include a one-line note showing both old and new keys for backward compatibility during rollout.
Rae (Docs): can you also add a short snippet showing how to toggle between latency vs p95 in the preset? customers often ask for that in examples.
Ivy (SDK): sure. adding this example in the snippet area: ```yaml
presets:
  labels:
    cost: billing.cpu
    latency: telemetry.p95
# fallback for older runtimes (optional)
# presets.costLabels: billing.cpu
```
Noor (Platform): small request: change absolute links in the example to relative ones (e.g. ../playground) so preview doesn't try to hit prod-only services. saw two links causing blocked network calls.
Felix (QA): once patched i will run the render smoke: `curl -s -X POST https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/api/render -d '{"example":"presets-cost-latency"}'` and attach the JSON output.
deploy-bot: PR 6210 status: preview-checks failed (snippet render exception)
Ivy (SDK): PR 6214 opened with updates: unified presets labels, added latency p95 example, and switched links to relative. also left a short migration callout in the doc: "presets.costLabels -> presets.labels.cost (and presets.labels.latency)".
Rae (Docs): nice. also found an orphaned example in /console/observability/samples/old-presets.yaml referencing `presets.costLabels`. can you remove it in the same PR? it clutters search results.
Ben (Eng-Obs): removing orphan and adding a changelog bullet. runtime shim keeps old behavior for now so this is non-breaking.
Felix (QA): smoke after merge: HTTP 200 and preview output shows `{"presets":{"labels":{"cost":"billing.cpu","latency":"telemetry.p95"}}}` and no stack traces. all good.
Rae (Docs): merging once CI green. leaving a tiny follow-up to add a cross-ref from the migration guide to the dashboard presets section. thanks team :sparkles:
